title: CONGRAD: Conflicting Gradient Filtering for Multilingual Preference Alignment
authors_zh: Jiangnan Li, Thuy-Trang Vu, Christian Herold, Amirhossein Tebbifakhr, Shahram Khadivi, Gholamreza Haffari（莫纳什大学、eBay Inc.）
paper_type_zh: 多语言偏好数据筛选与迭代对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合设计多语言偏好学习流程、希望保留跨语言迁移又避免一种语言的更新损害另一种语言的读者。
one_line: CONGRAD filters self-generated multilingual preference pairs by their alignment with a de-conflicted consensus gradient before DPO consumes them.
CONGRAD 在 DPO 使用自生成的多语言偏好回答对之前，依据其与去冲突共识梯度的一致程度进行筛选。
why: It operationalizes cross-language training interference as a record-selection criterion instead of treating all generated preference pairs as equally safe to optimize on.
inclusion_reason: It changes which newly self-generated preference pairs enter multilingual DPO by selecting records whose gradients support a shared cross-lingual update rather than conflict with it.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Joint preference alignment across languages can improve weak languages through transfer, but it can also make language-specific objectives pull the shared model in incompatible directions. A translated or self-generated pair may be a valid preference example within its own language while still pushing parameters away from what benefits the other languages. Treating every pair as equally trainable therefore makes multilingual data volume a poor proxy for useful training signal.

CONGRAD asks how an iterative preference-learning loop can decide which multilingual pairs to keep when the cost of a record is not only label noise but also cross-language interference. The paper frames the decision at the level of training examples: select pairs that support a shared update direction and reject pairs likely to create conflicts. Its target is the data that reaches optimization, rather than a new multilingual benchmark or a new preference objective.

跨语言联合偏好对齐能够通过迁移帮助能力较弱的语言，但也可能让各语言特有的目标以不兼容的方向拉动同一个模型。一个经过翻译或自生成的回答对，在本语言内可以是有效的偏好示例，却仍可能把参数推向不利于其他语言的方向。因此，把每个回答对都视为同样适合训练，会使多语言数据量成为有用训练信号的不可靠替代指标。

CONGRAD 询问：在迭代偏好学习循环中，当一条记录的代价不仅是标签噪声、还包括跨语言干扰时，应如何决定保留哪些多语言回答对。论文把决策放在训练示例层面：选择支持共享更新方向的回答对，拒绝可能制造冲突的回答对。它的目标是进入优化的数据，而不是新的多语言基准或新的偏好目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The method represents each language by an exponential moving average of its recent preference-training gradients. It removes mutually conflicting components from these language-level vectors with the PCGrad projection rule and sums the adjusted vectors into one consensus gradient. This makes “cross-lingual affinity” concrete: a candidate record is desirable when its own loss gradient points in a similar direction to the consensus.

The consensus is used to filter newly self-generated preference data, not to rewrite model gradients directly. For every language, CONGRAD keeps the records with the highest cosine similarity to the consensus and then applies length-penalized DPO to the retained pairs. Low-rank compression lets the procedure retain language gradient histories without storing a full dense gradient for every language, so the selection rule can be inserted into a repeated self-rewarding loop.

该方法用近期偏好训练梯度的指数移动平均来表示每一种语言。它利用 PCGrad 的投影规则移除这些语言级向量之间彼此冲突的分量，再把调整后的向量相加为一个共识梯度。这样，“跨语言亲和性”变得具体：当候选记录自身的损失梯度与该共识指向相近时，这条记录就是值得保留的。

共识用于筛选新近自生成的偏好数据，而不是直接改写模型梯度。对于每种语言，CONGRAD 保留与共识余弦相似度最高的记录，再对留下的回答对执行长度惩罚的 DPO。低秩压缩使流程不必为每种语言保存完整稠密梯度，也能保留其梯度历史，因此这一选择规则可以嵌入反复进行的自奖励循环。

title: Method
方法
html:
In each round, the current instruction model generates four answers for every prompt and self-evaluates them to form chosen-rejected pairs. The first round trains on all such pairs. From the second round onward, the algorithm maintains one compressed gradient EMA per language, projects away negative pairwise dot-product components across languages, and sums the de-conflicted vectors into a consensus direction.

It then computes each candidate pair's instantaneous length-penalized DPO gradient and ranks pairs within their language by cosine similarity to that direction. The main experiments retain the top half of every language's records, train for one DPO epoch, and repeat for five rounds. They start from Llama 3-8B-Instruct or Gemma 2-2B-Instruct, use one thousand AlpaGasus prompts partitioned into ten languages, and compare against full-data, random, length-margin, reward-margin, and language-scheduling baselines.

在每一轮中，当前指令模型为每条提示生成四个回答，并自行评估它们以形成优劣回答对。第一轮在所有此类回答对上训练。从第二轮起，算法为每种语言维护一个压缩梯度指数移动平均，移除语言之间点积为负的成分，并把去冲突后的向量相加为共识方向。

随后，它计算每个候选回答对瞬时的长度惩罚 DPO 梯度，并按其与该方向的余弦相似度在语言内部排序。主要实验保留每种语言中前一半的记录，训练一个 DPO 轮次，并重复五轮。实验以 Llama 3-8B-Instruct 或 Gemma 2-2B-Instruct 为起点，使用一千条被划分到十种语言的 AlpaGasus 提示，并与全量数据、随机、长度间隔、奖励间隔和语言调度基线比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the multilingual Aya instruction-following evaluation, the best Llama result from consensus-gradient selection reaches a 73.22% average win rate after five rounds, compared with 66.52% for multilingual self-rewarding on all data; for Gemma, the corresponding values are 69.22% and 59.53%. The paper also compares random filtering, minimum and maximum response-length margins, minimum and maximum reward margins, and two language-level schedules. Maximum reward margin is competitive, but the consensus-gradient choice is best in the reported main table.

The analysis extends beyond the ten languages used during training. On Hindi, Vietnamese, and Russian, the selected-data procedure remains stronger than full-data training in the reported rounds. It also improves four languages with limited Llama tokenizer support relative to the full-data and reward-filtering variants. Global MMLU and multilingual ARC Challenge do not show a material alignment tax, while the runtime table reports about 1.1 times the five-epoch cost of naive self-rewarding for Gemma 2-2B.

在多语言 Aya 指令遵循评测上，共识梯度选择的最佳 Llama 结果在五轮后达到 73.22% 的平均胜率，而在全量数据上进行多语言自奖励为 66.52%；对 Gemma，对应数值为 69.22% 和 59.53%。论文还比较了随机筛选、最小与最大回答长度间隔、最小与最大奖励间隔，以及两种语言级调度。最大奖励间隔具有竞争力，但共识梯度选择在报告的主表中最佳。

分析并未止于训练所用的十种语言。对于印地语、越南语和俄语，所选数据流程在报告的轮次中仍强于全量数据训练。相对于全量数据和奖励筛选变体，它也改善了四种 Llama 分词器支持有限的语言。全球多学科理解评测与多语言科学推理评测没有显示显著的对齐代价，而运行时间表表明，对 Gemma 2-2B 而言，五个训练轮次的成本约为朴素自奖励的 1.1 倍。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Many multilingual alignment methods either translate a dataset, change sampling schedules, or modify optimization gradients after a batch has been chosen. CONGRAD instead makes gradient conflict a property of individual preference records and applies the remedy before the records become training data. That separation matters because it permits a standard DPO update while changing the data mixture that the update sees.

The method also combines a cross-language consensus with an iterative self-rewarding data loop. Its low-rank EMA implementation is not just an efficiency add-on: without compressed per-language gradient histories, the proposed record-level test would be impractical at the reported model scale. The paper therefore contributes a selection criterion, an executable mechanism for maintaining it, and evidence that it favors cross-lingually transferable preference signal over merely high self-reward.

许多多语言对齐方法要么翻译数据集，要么改变采样日程，要么在选定一批数据后修改优化梯度。CONGRAD 则把梯度冲突变成单条偏好记录的属性，并在记录成为训练数据之前施加修正。这一区分很重要，因为它能保持标准的 DPO 更新，同时改变该更新所见的数据混合。

该方法还把跨语言共识与迭代自奖励数据循环结合起来。其低秩 EMA 实现不只是效率附加项：如果没有压缩的逐语言梯度历史，所提出的记录级检验就无法在报告的模型规模上实际运行。因此，论文同时贡献了一个选择准则、一个维护该准则的可执行机制，以及表明它更偏向可跨语言迁移的偏好信号而非单纯高自奖励的证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors note that low-rank compression introduces approximation noise into filtering, that the experiments use typologically varied but relatively balanced languages, and that severely imbalanced or very low-resource cases remain untested. The rule can also reject culturally specific or linguistically untranslatable examples even when they are locally valid, because it prioritizes transferability to a shared direction. Filtering is static at the round level rather than dynamically updated within training, and the data are translated from English prompts, so the results do not establish that the same behavior holds for naturally sourced multilingual instructions.
作者指出，低秩压缩会给筛选引入近似噪声，实验使用的是类型上多样但相对均衡的语言，而严重不均衡或资源极低的情形仍未验证。由于该规则优先考虑向共享方向的可迁移性，它也可能拒绝在本地有效、却具有文化特异性或语言上不可直译的示例。筛选在轮次层面静态进行，并非在训练内部动态更新；同时数据由英文提示翻译而来，因此结果并不能证明同样行为会出现在自然来源的多语言指令上。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This paper is most useful when a team already has multilingual prompts and a way to generate or label preference pairs, but observes uneven progress across languages. It supplies a concrete audit quantity—each record's agreement with a cross-language update—and a conservative selection point before DPO. It is especially relevant for self-rewarding loops, where poor records can recur across rounds, but the same principle can guide offline preference-data triage if per-record gradients are affordable to compute.
当团队已有多语言提示和生成或标注偏好回答对的方法，却观察到各语言进展不均时，这篇论文最有用。它提供了一个具体的审计量——每条记录与跨语言更新的一致程度——以及 DPO 之前的保守选择位置。它尤其适用于自奖励循环，因为低质量记录会在多轮中反复出现；若计算每记录梯度的成本可接受，同一原则也可用于离线偏好数据的分流。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Figure 1 and Algorithm 1 together first: they distinguish the consensus-gradient construction from the later per-record ranking. Then compare Table 1 with the reward-margin baseline, because the practical claim is not simply that filtering helps but that gradient agreement adds information beyond a self-reward score. Finally inspect Tables 2–5 and the limitations section before adopting the method: the evidence is promising for seen, unseen, and underrepresented languages, but it remains tied to translated prompts, two relatively small instruction models, and a five-round self-rewarding setup.
先把图 1 与算法 1 放在一起阅读：它们区分了共识梯度的构造和之后逐记录的排序。然后将表 1 与奖励间隔基线比较，因为实际主张不只是筛选有帮助，而是梯度一致性在自奖励分数之外增加了信息。最后，在采用该方法前检查表 2 至表 5 和局限部分：它对已见、未见和代表不足语言的证据颇有希望，但仍受限于翻译提示、两个相对较小的指令模型以及五轮自奖励设置。
